indicator_definition: Trade openness is measured as total exports plus imports of goods and services as a percentage of GDP. It indicates the degree of integration into the global trading system. Data are compiled from national accounts by Eurostat.
rationale: Open trade promotes economic growth and development. Progress means maintaining openness in support of sustainable development goals.
methodology_characteristics: Data are compiled from national accounts under ESA 2010. Exports and imports cover goods and services. Published annually by Eurostat.
